description: Score a GitHub repository's authenticity: pulls the repo through the GitHub API and checks the fake-star / astroturf fingerprint (stars-vs-forks, star velocity, missing language/license, product-named org, keyword-stuffed topics, hype description). Returns a 0-100 authenticity score, a verdict (likely-authentic/suspicious/likely-faked) and the evidence list. Free, no key.

repo.description: owner/name or a full github.com URL

name: starproof_score
